rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:=  '%s';
SET @cat_id :=  '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET  @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_persontype (
	id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
	hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
	areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
	flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
	date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
	b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	type1 INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type2 INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type3 INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type4 INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type5 INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type1c INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type2c INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type3c INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type4c INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
	type5c INT(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,areacode,b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_persontype WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_persontype(
SELECT
@id,h.hoscode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) 
 ,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,t1.type1,t1.type2,t1.type3,t1.type4,t1.type5
,t2.type1,t2.type2,t2.type3,t2.type4,t2.type5
FROM
(SELECT HOSPCODE
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(1), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(2), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(3), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(4), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(5), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type5
FROM t_person_db WHERE DISCHARGE IN(9)
GROUP BY HOSPCODE) t1  
INNER JOIN chospital h ON t1.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode in(@prov_c)
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT HOSPCODE
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(1), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(2), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(3), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(4), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TYPEAREA IN(5), CONCAT(HOSPCODE,'-',PID),NULL)) type5
FROM t_person_cid  WHERE DISCHARGE IN(9)
GROUP BY HOSPCODE) t2 ON t1.hospcode =t2.hospcode
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("type1") as "type1" ,SUM("type2") as "type2" ,SUM("type3") as "type3" ,SUM("type4") as "type4" ,SUM("type5") as "type5" ,SUM("type1c") as "type1c" ,SUM("type2c") as "type2c" ,SUM("type3c") as "type3c" ,SUM("type4c") as "type4c" ,SUM("type5c") as "type5c"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
